question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute ABS DWV piping for the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping in Section 22 13 16 prior to ordering material.
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV piping as an alternate to the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
routing_rationale: Per routing policy, substitution requests with a cost impact are routed to the Cost/Change-Order Manager regardless of discipline.
